newsitem.title: MEXICO: Accelsa plans 172 mln peso share issue.
newsitem.headline: Accelsa plans 172 mln peso share issue.

text.p: Holding company Accel SA de CV (Accelsa) plans to increase its share capital by 171.88 million pesos, through issuing 12 million A series shares, as agreed at an extraordinary shareholders' assembly held October 7, the company said on Thursday.

Accelsa will issue 0.4178245 new share for each currently outstanding share, the company said in a report to the Mexican Stock Exchange. The number of A series shares would increase to 40.72 million after the issue.
Accel is a holding company for firms trading in real estate, manufacturing, apparel and warehousing.
